in_sanskrit.name: Gnesh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Ganesha
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gnesh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ganesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ganana' meaning 'to count', and 'ishta' meaning 'dear to'. Lord Ganesha is known as the remover of obstacles, and the god of wisdom and good fortune. He is revered and loved by millions of Hindus all over the world.
